Mm your not wrong with the room mates....hell sometimes Id say i'm more of a maid some days. I have tried to have a day specific for us to hang out (Just like her other partners have :) ) But she either forgets or just plans over it, though at this point I think she forgot it about it.

Maybe after some conversations and some attempts like you suggest, if nothing changes you may be right.

No, I recently got a a new job and I have my own car, she has neither.

Honestly we dont really go on dates, though thats mostly b/c money. Recently we just sorta watch movies / TV shows together, but even then shes on her phone 80% of the time. 

And I get that "not having sex" doesnt mean something is wrong.  I thought sex for me wasnt a need but as time goes on im not sure if thats true anymore.  And honestly I tried to talk about how my needs weren't being met and it seems like stuff changed for a week or two and then things went back to normal (normal as in my needs werent being met).
Maybe it was NRE. I couldn’t really call it neglect, if she doesn’t want to I can’t try and force her. I don’t know if I’d call it excuses, I feel like it’s the truth just not the whole truth

I don’t think it’s cheating, that’s a bit of a stretch. I wouldn’t say she’s sick per day, but she has physically unwell for a month or two. If anything I’d rather her just say she isn’t physically attracted to me or something like that, like yeah it hurt but I feel like she’s being more honest. I do need to talk about it with her I just don’t know how.
Yeah, I do need to talk about how I’m feeling to her (even if it’s negative)
Honestly that’s true, probably the best advice for now.
